images.title: Full rows of four, or two left over
images.purpose: Shows the two kinds of even numbers: multiples of 4 fill rows of four, the others leave 2 dots over.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. Two dot grids side by side with a wide gap, each with its number above and its form below.
images.exact_structure: Left grid: 3 rows of 4 teal (#0072B2) dots, 12 dots, every row full. Above it: 12. Below it: 4p. Right grid: 4 full rows of 4 teal (#0072B2) dots and a fifth row with only 2 amber (#E69F00) dots at its left end, 18 dots in all. Above it: 18. Below it: 4p + 2. A small amber (#E69F00) ring around the 2 amber dots with the label 2 left over beside it. All dots the same size. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Every even number either fills rows of four (4p) or leaves 2 over (4p + 2).
images.description: Shows the two kinds of even numbers: multiples of 4 fill rows of four, the others leave 2 dots over.

image_decisions.why: Dot grids in rows of four make the two remainder types visible with the concept's own numbers.
